turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
—damage is handled differently from a normal “change of mind” return.
If the item arrived damaged (or we shipped the wrong item / it doesn’t function as intended), we’ll fix it at no cost to you—just let us know within 7 days of receiving it.
A normal return is typically for unused items within the return window (30 days standard, or 60 days with Checkout+), and return shipping/restocking rules may apply depending on your order and item condition. Is the damaged item a bike or a part/accessory?
